name: Thespian's Stage copying Urza's Saga — chapter abilities wait for the Stage's own lore counters
notes: A copy is re-parsed from the copied text (_reParseAfterTextChange), and the parser gated Saga chapter lines only when the parsed permanent was itself printed as a Saga (_sagaChapterThresholds). Thespian's Stage that became a copy of Urza's Saga with no lore counters gained both chapter abilities in Layer 6. The re-parse now passes isSaga when the copy is a Saga, so each chapter waits for the Stage's own lore counters: with none it gains neither, with one it gains only chapter I. Urza's Saga with two counters keeps both.
